profile.headline: Senior AI/ML Platform Engineer
profile.summary: I’m a Software Engineer focused on building and supporting scalable AI/ML platforms and observability infrastructure at Dell Technologies. I have played a key role in architecting centralized AI platforms, improving observability for complex AI systems, and contributing to full-stack development to enhance platform usability and integration. My work spans backend API design, container orchestration, monitoring pipeline development, and data visualization —empowering AI/ML teams to deliver reliable, transparent, and high-impact solutions.

positions.title: Senior LLMOps Engineer
positions.description:
•  Deploy and operate open-source LLMs on K8s GPU infrastructure and cloud models (Azure OpenAI, GCP), with a unified gateway for routing and auth.
•  Run performance and load testing across models and serving (vLLM, SGLang), benchmarking time to first token, time per output token, latency, concurrency, and cost to guide model selection and capacity planning.
positions.insights: OpenAI API, Azure OpenAI and +8 skills

positions.title: Senior AI/ML Fullstack Engineer
positions.description:
•  Designed and architected a centralized, enterprise-scale AI platform, allowing unified, organization-wide access to machine learning tools, workflows, and services.
•  Led development for full-stack initiatives, features and integrations, enhancing platform scalability, user experience, and cross-team adoption.
•  Mentored and coached junior engineers, enabling technical skill growth, career progression, and a culture of continuous learning within the team.

positions.title: AI/ML Observability Engineer
positions.description:
•  Led efforts to enhance observability across AI/ML infrastructure, delivering capabilities for monitoring, logging, and tracing to support large-scale data operations.
•  Developed and maintained data pipelines to collect and process platform metrics, ensuring reliability and high availability.
•  Built dashboards and alerting systems to provide actionable insights and support system health and performance.
•  Supported ongoing optimization of monitoring systems to improve issue detection, root cause analysis, and system transparency.

positions.title: Accounting Assistant
positions.description:
• Served as a support person in the Accounts Payable area by keeping track of the payables email.
• Used Quickbooks as a tool to enter receipts, invoices, and any other bills pertaining to company spending.
• Reconciled credit card statements, wrote journal entries, and created / sent out lien waivers.
• Provided receipts and documentation to support expenses on a project worth over $400k.
positions.insights: Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint and +4 skills

company.name: Full Circle Restoration and Construction Services, Inc.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Redefined website hosted for HSOC Department and uploaded important documentation relating to the NSF South
Africa/United States Partnership (Stem) Workshop (July: Cape Town, South Africa).
• Transcribed the Workshop Conference in Cape Town, South Africa.
